items.statement: Company raising INR100 crores via convertible warrants on preferential basis over 18 months; INR24.27 crores already received
items.quote: I would also like to mention that the company is raising INR100 crores through issue of convertible warrants on preferential basis over the next 18 months. Of this, we have already received INR24.27 crores.

items.statement: Positive operating cash flow of Rs. 74.70 crores in FY24
items.quote: This year, we closed with positive operational cash flow of Rs. 74.70 crores.

items.statement: Promoters offloaded 11% stake via block deal in Tips Music to fund film production
items.quote: We have already told you that we will offlo ad our some percentage, promoters will offload something. And we did bulk deal of 11% and we got money

items.statement: Direct tax cash outflow of INR50 lakhs in cash flow statement is TDS deducted by Netflix and others
items.quote: It is a TDS amount deducted by the Netflix and other.

items.statement: INR70 crores in other current assets represents investment in feature films including Ishq Vishq and forthcoming projects
items.quote: It is an investment in feature films. It includes Ishq Vishq also and other forthcoming projects.

items.statement: Decrease of INR35 crores in other current assets due to Merry Christmas movie release and write-off
items.quote: Only INR35 crores in forthcoming projects. It was 79 in last year. Out of that, Merry Christmas movie has been released.

items.statement: Gross cash increased by Rs.6 crores from Rs.109 to Rs.115 crores despite Rs.10 crore buyback
items.quote: gross cash has increased by about Rs.6 crores from Rs.109 to Rs.115 crores and our net cash , though, has decreased post buyback from Rs.99 Rs.95 crores

items.statement: Rs.10 crore buyback executed during the year
items.quote: cash position currently seems to be pretty healthy despite a Rs.10crore buyback which we affected during the year

items.statement: Increased stake in 361DM from 11% to 39% in February 2024, now close to 54% post second phase
items.quote: Our borrowings also increased due to the consolidation of 361D egree Minds Consulting Pvt. Ltd.(“361 DM) in which we increased our share from 11 %-39% in February 2024 and now post the second phase of the transaction we are now close to 54

items.statement: Board approved enabling provision for equity infusion up to INR300 crores for growth, capabilities, and debt repayment
items.quote: there was in the last board meeting there was an enabling provision for looking at an equity infusion at the right time in the right quantum.

items.statement: Equity infusion up to INR300 crores approved by board for intellectual expansion, capabilities, and near-term debt repayment
items.quote: the board feels and has approved the equity infusion up to INR300 crores. That's what they've approved.

items.statement: Government project receivables expected to reduce to INR600-800 crore over 12-18 months and INR400-500 crore thereafter
items.quote: Our target, I think, over the next 12 to 18 months , approximately, is to bring down the government project receivables almost close to abou t somewhere between INR600 crores to INR800 crores on a net basis because we'll still be doing some amount of project business, as we complete the remainder of the

items.statement: Receivables in FY23 were INR900+ crore, came down to INR894 crore in FY24, expected to reach INR400-500 crore in 12-18 months
items.quote: And the receivables, in FY '23, were INR900 and odd crores. They came down to INR894 crores in FY '24. And as w e do this recovery, as I said, over 12 to 18 months, the receivables are expected to be down to close to about approximately INR400 crores to INR500 crores level during this period

items.statement: Retail business receivable days improved to 26 days in March 2024 from 34 days in March 2023
items.quote: If I really look at it for March '24, overall retail business, the receiva ble days are 26 days, and which is an improvement of almost 8 days compared to March '23

items.statement: India net working capital cycle improved from 250 days in March 2023 to 235 days in March 2024
items.quote: So in Mar ch '23, we were at 250 days net working capital cycle, we are down to 235

items.statement: Promoter pledges to be brought down to zero over next year plus period
items.quote: Yes, I think that is the thought process, which we have that as we move forward, we should bring down the pledge to 0, that is definitely the plan at a family, at a promoter level we have. And -- so that is still an ongoing process that it should get done over next year plus during that period of time, it should happen.

items.statement: Equity infused in the company during the year, informed to investors time to time
items.quote: In terms of other overall developments during the year, we have got certain amount of equity infused in the company during the year, which time to time we already informed all the investors in the market.

items.statement: Export credit period reduced from 180 days to 45 days; average credit period cut from 100 days to 60 days
items.quote: So, earlier in exports, we were giving about 180 days credit, which is down to 45. There were a lot of our customers, which were at 90 days, we brought them down to 60 days. So, our average credit period is now down to, I would say, from a high of 100 days to about 60 days on an average.

items.statement: Supplier credit period increased from 30 days to 45 days
items.quote: We've also increased our credit period with some of our suppliers from 30 days to 45 days, which kind of gives us a leverage both ways.

items.statement: Planning substantial acquisition using cash and possibly stock in current financial year
items.quote: We are now looking at acquisitions very actively and we are very confident that in the current financial year, we will be able to do a substantial acquisition with whatever cash that the company holds currently and maybe some stock.

items.statement: DSO reduced by 20% due to disciplined weekly collection reviews, reflecting in higher cash balance
items.quote: I'm very happy to inform you that our receivables position today, our DSO is down by 20%. It is because of a lot of discipline with which we are looking at and reviewing our collections on a weekly basis

items.statement: Cash balance increased from INR37.99 crores to INR64.62 crores in FY24
items.quote: And the good thing is that cash balance has been commendably, it increased from INR37.99 crores to INR64.62 crores.

items.statement: ESOP trust scheme created to reward segment leaders; trust will buy back shares from open market to avoid dilution
items.quote: So, we have also actually created the ESOP trust scheme whereby we are planning to we are adding a lot of segment leaders with the company who come with extensive experience in that domain and to help us reward them better. We have created a trust which would ensure that the employees are rewarded. And at the same time, the shareholding is not diluted as much.

items.statement: Plan to sell old office property and use proceeds for share buyback
items.quote: The idea is precisely what you've mentioned, Mr. Abhiram, the idea is to see how we can probably look at selling this property, and those proceeds, we will definitely see how we can invest in buying back as well.

items.statement: Auditor change led to a one-time deferred tax charge of INR7.9 crores in Q4 FY24, which is a non-cash item and will be reversed in subsequent years.
items.quote: So, there are certain change in as suggested by the auditor. because this year, we have the different auditor.

items.statement: The deferred tax charge of INR7.9 crores is a non-cash item with no impact on actual tax payment and will be adjusted against future tax expenses.
items.quote: And it is purely noncash item. There is no link to the actual tax payment. And that will be adjusted against the future tax expenses, like the defer tax expenses.

items.statement: Raised INR 55 crores equity in FY24, with INR 10 crores from promoters and INR 4.92 crores in March; plans to raise INR 150 crores in H1 FY25
items.quote: On equity front, we raised INRSS crores, which is the largest equity raise since inception. Out of this, almost INR10 crores came up from promoters and INR4.92 crores camein March itself. Now we soon plan to raise another INR150 crores in H1°25 to fund our FY 25 extension plan, and process for the same is initiated

items.statement: APL Apollo subscribed to warrants and holds 37% of turnover; no further shareholding changes expected
items.quote: They have subscribed to the warrants. I think that's going on. There shouldn't be any change in the shareholding, no changes expected.

items.statement: Cash and bank balances increased to INR34 crores from INR12 crores in previous year
items.quote: Our cash and bank balances for the year stood at INR34 crores compare to INR12 crores in the last year.

items.statement: Working capital maintained at around 30 days with inventory 30 days, debtors 40 days, creditors 40 days
items.quote: For t he second part for the inventory will be approximately around 30 the days. Debtors approximately 40 days, and creditors will be around 40 days. So net average will be around 30 days

items.statement: Operating cash flow generation expected to be positive in FY25 with cash breakeven in API subsidiary
items.quote: There may be cash breakeven. Yes, we are anticipating cash breakeven there.

items.statement: ESOP pool of up to 5% of paid-up capital approved for API subsidiary
items.quote: We have in the API, got an approval from the shareholders and the investors up to 5% of the total paid up capital.

items.statement: Free cash flow of INR7-8 crores available due to reduced inventory and better debtor control
items.quote: We have, I mean, free cash flows available to the tune of INR7 crores to INR8 crores. That is possible because we have reduced the inventory and als o got better debtor control as compared to the previous year

items.statement: Board approved Rs 43.9 crore equity infusion via preferential allotment of shares and warrants; Rs 28.9 crore received by end-March against shares and 25% of warrants.
items.quote: In the 4 th quarter the board of directors approved the infusion of Rs. 43.9 crores of equity by way of preferential allotment of equity shares and warrants. Of this Rs. 28.9 crores approximately was received at the end of March against the preferential allotment of equity shares and 25% of the warrants that were issued.

items.statement: Management says no dilution is planned in the next 12 months but will update when expansion plans are finalized.
items.quote: Sir, nothing planned right now. We have too many things. It is too early for me to state anything. But there are too many things going on in our mind with their expansions and we will definitely be coming back to you the way we plan.
